asr.full_text: Hello! In this video I will briefly talk about the frantic Ethereum Commission's that coincided with the launch of xGold. Before the launch, on January 3, Ethereum had already started to grow and during the day there was a movement from about $750 to $1,100 and above. Ethereum commissions depend on the loath of the blockchain. And the loath is huge, at last days. And the load of the blockchain. And the load is huge at last days. And the participants faced a dilemma. Or wait for the commissions to return to normal values, and usually the commissions are insignificant. Either paying more expensive now, but then catching this start wave when it is much easier to make money quickly. In general, many were unable to activate so starting in x gold right now you still find yourself in the first rows. Many are just waiting for the commission to decrease and someone is waiting for the heather to fall and want to buy it cheaper but they risk buying it even expensive because the chances of farther growth are very high. It seems that Forsage xgoal provoked a sharp takeoff of Ether. How do you like it? Of course, it is joke. Although Forsage is already a fairly large player, members of our community have earned more than $1 billion at the moment and this is just the beginning.we have a rich roadmap. The most interesting is ahead. So, maybe over time Forsage will really begin to noticeably affect the rate of cryptocurrencies.X-Gold is a unique smart contract synchronization with the site turned out to be more difficult than usual, and many participants at first hours after launch faced the fact that the site did not work, and they activated the slots without a site. Then the work of the site was adjusted, but just in case, it is better to always be ready to act directly with Smart contract. ForSash Academy has instructions for activating slots both from the side and without the side. For links to instructions see the description for the video. In Xgold, it is very simple to activate slots without the website. You need just to send the corresponding amount directly to the xGoldSmart contract. That is, it is 0.05 Ethereum for the 1st slot, 0.1 for the 2nd slot, etc. Now I will tell you in what cases transaction failures occur. Failure is frustrating because the commission from your wallet will still be debited. So let's not fail oftentimes transaction failures are due to the wrong slot activation order if you buy more than one you must first buy the first slot for 0.05 Ethereum then the second for 0.1 then for 0.2 for 0.3 etc make sure that transaction was successful before proceeding with the next one so as not to try to buy ahead of time in addition be careful make sure to send exactly to the X Gold Ethereum smart contract there is known case when a participant attest four slots correctly but then sent several of the following transactions 0.5, 0.8, and 1.3 not to a smart contract but to the partners wallet. Then he again filled the address of the smart contract correctly and tried to send 2.1 etherium for the next slot but the transaction of course did not go through. Another possible reason of failure is the low guess limit. When you activate the slot from the site, then the required commission is automatically adjusted in Metamask or in Trust Wallet. If you send manually, then there is default the usual guess limit for a regular transaction – from wallet to wallet twenty one thousands but in a smart contract there are much more complex transactions there is the matrix structure and referral links and the order of payments etc better to put seven hundred thousands it is with a margin usually need much less but just in case it is better to set with a margin. All the same they will not take excess gas from you but return it to your wallet. What is a gas limit? Imagine driving from point a to point B. The journey is a transaction and there is no way to refill on the way. If you need 30 liters of gasoline for your way but fill in only 20 liters, then you won't get to point B, but you will waste gasoline. Also, the transaction will not take place if the gas limit is not enough, but the commission will be spent. And if you fill in 40 liters, then that's enough for you and you still have 10 liters left. Also, the excess gas limit will remain unspent for you, so do not be afraid to enter with the margin. How much will the fuel cost you? Gasoline price per liter multiplied by the number of liters spent. In transactions, similarly, there is a gas price, and if you multiply the gas price by the amount of gas spent you get the cost of the commission in Etherium. You can set any price for gas but mining machines let more expensive transactions go ahead first and if your price is too low, then the transaction may get stuck pending. This is can be fixed. If the pending is too long, you can speed up the transaction by adding gas. In any case, these are usually small amounts. But when the activity of the network increases greatly, everyone strives to be ahead, and they offer prices more and more expensive. MetaMask automatically adjusts the current recommended commission for you. You can check the current recommended price on Ethereum gas tracker. You will find the link to that page under the video. In the past few days the rise in gas prices reached the point that they had to pay a commission of up to 0.1 ether and even higher. Nevertheless, in the first days in the new smart contract there were already more than 14 000 transactions and the ex gold smart contract entered the top three in terms of gas volumes in Ethereum network. It is important to note that Forsage does't take any commissions from anyone. Miners earn on commissions thanks to which the blockchain is held and transactions take place. At the same time, hundreds of thousands of participants are waiting for the normal commissions to settle in order to enter the program. This is a colossal opportunity to earn more Ethereum which could grow significantly over the course of 2021 with the transition to Ethereum 2.0, which will have lower fees and faster transactions. I remind you that you will find all important relevant links in the description for this video. Go through them, study the information and act.
